node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal source-line remaining payment
node.statement: In the active bridge image of the diagonal source-line branch, the proved c2(2,0,2) exclusion and saturated c2(1,1,2) source-line exclusion contribute zero. Every remaining source-line packet in rows (1,0,4), (0,1,4), the near-aligned part of (0,0,6), and the exceptional unsaturated (1,1,2) orbit is empty or has a printed exact distinct-affine-slope payment with bridge multiplicity and active chronology. The theorem outputs U_source_line.
node.falsifier: A source-line packet outside the five-row mixing census, a claimed-zero packet that survives, an omitted exceptional orbit, or an owner/multiplicity error in a nonzero payment.
